_comment: Schema-validated by tools/build/island-lib.mjs::validateAllowlistDoc, enforced fail-closed by tools/build/island-scan.mjs. Every entry MUST be an exact crate identity (no wildcards), reference a real, currently-existing workspace crate, carry evidence + evidence_fingerprint + owner + reason + created/expires (ISO 8601, expires - created <= grace_period_days_max), and link a real tracking issue in this repo. A malformed entry invalidates the whole file (fail-closed, no partial trust). `evidence` is human-readable documentation ONLY, never authoritative on its own. `evidence_fingerprint` is the actual machine-checked authority: a SHA-256 digest (tools/build/island-lib.mjs::computeIslandEvidenceFingerprint) over the crate's current structured classification evidence (identity, version, target kinds, sorted production/dev/build edges with source crate/features/target, policy version). Compute it with `node tools/build/island-scan.mjs --print-fingerprint <crate>`. applyAllowlistPolicy recomputes and compares this fingerprint on every run: any drift (new/removed/renamed caller, feature/target change, or the crate becoming LIVE/ENTRYPOINT) makes the entry stale and fails the gate closed until it is regranted with a fresh fingerprint or removed — it never passes silently. Do not add an entry without opening/linking the tracking issue first. -- 2026-09-16 HARD REFOUNDATION note: all 11 prior exceptions (the entire chronica-digital-twin-* family, PR #5276/DT.REVISION-1 Wave C, issue #5286) were removed here, not because their underlying reachability concern was resolved, but because the backend reset deleted the crates/ tree those crates lived in entirely -- island-scan.mjs's own schema validation confirmed all 11 as referencing crates that are no longer workspace members. See docs/decisions/0016-legacy-backend-retired-to-git-history.md. Removed: chronica-digital-twin-model, chronica-digital-twin-time, chronica-digital-twin-shadow, chronica-digital-twin-store, chronica-digital-twin-estimation, chronica-digital-twin-simulation, chronica-digital-twin-scenario, chronica-digital-twin-divergence, chronica-digital-twin-evidence, chronica-digital-twin-fmi, chronica-digital-twin-testkit.
